rows.itemTitle: FRANCHISOR ASSISTANCE ADVERTISING COMPUTER SYSTEMS AND TRAINING
rows.summary: Between 2017 and 2022, Item 11 was fundamentally restructured around advertising: the contingent no-current Advertising Fund was replaced by a mandatory 1% Brand Fund with a reserved 2% cap, while site selection fees rose $1,000 to $5,000, optional opening assistance rose $400 to $500 per day, additional training rose $35 to $50 per hour, POS maintenance was newly capped at $8,000 per three-year period, and the opening termination deadline moved from one year to eighteen months.
